jtbd.jtbd_title: Draft CMU Pre-College essays with scene-first evidence
jtbd.jtbd_desc: Convert abstract claims into concrete scenes; produce outline → draft1 with tight word budgets.

facts.name: core_theme
facts.value: building for others via AI + journalism

interactions.user_ask: My draft sounds generic—how do I make it pop?
interactions.jenny_reply: Pick one hallway‑moment and zoom in on 8–10 vivid beats. Cut every sentence that doesn’t move the scene.

interactions.user_ask: How do I fit my impact in 300 words?
interactions.jenny_reply: Use a 3–2–1 structure: 3 lines of setup, 2 of conflict, 1 of impact with a link to proof.
Return to the opening image with a twist—same scene, new agency.
